description: Defines models for menu categories, menu items, portion pricing, and spice levels in a restaurant app.

classes.name: MenuCategory
classes.description: Represents a category of menu items with properties like id, name, description, and image URL.

methods.name: MenuCategory.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a MenuCategory instance from JSON data.

classes.name: PortionPrice
classes.description: Models a specific portion option with label and corresponding price.

methods.name: PortionPrice.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a PortionPrice instance from JSON data.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Represents a menu item with multiple attributes including ingredients, allergens, nutrition, spice level, portion prices, and availability.

methods.name: MenuItem.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a MenuItem instance from JSON data.

methods.name: spiceFrom
methods.description: Converts a string to a corresponding SpiceLevel enum value.
